tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: The frame. Top half of every app screen, the Welcome screen, primary buttons on light ground, the on state of switches, the selected chip on light ground.

tokens.name: slate-ink
tokens.usage: Raised surface on slate (the account card) and text or badge fill on sand.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: The one accent. Used once per screen for the next thing to do: Review button on Home, selected filter on slate, category on a transaction, progress on Review, Get started on Welcome. Text on sand is slate-ink (8.9:1).

tokens.name: on-slate
tokens.usage: Text, figures and icons on slate and slate-ink (9.6:1 on slate).

tokens.name: on-slate-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on slate: labels such as Total balance, This week, step counts (5.6:1 on slate).

tokens.name: ghost-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of icon buttons, search fields and unselected chips on slate.

tokens.name: ghost-line
tokens.usage: Border of icon buttons, search fields and unselected chips on slate; inactive progress segments on slate.

tokens.name: chart-bar
tokens.usage: Past days in the week chart on slate. Today's bar is sand.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The sheet and the page behind onboarding. Everything you read and act on sits here.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, secondary buttons and unselected chips on surface.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Icon wells behind transaction arrows and list icons, on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, row dividers, the tab bar's top edge. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Inactive step segments, the off track of a switch, the or-divider on sign in.

tokens.name: handle
tokens.usage: The grab handle at the top of a sheet.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface and surface-raised (13.6:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface and surface-raised: row sublines, day headers, field labels, helper text (5.3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Inactive tab icons, and the amount and arrow of transfers between your own accounts (deliberately quiet, 3.4:1). Not for other text.

tokens.name: money-in
tokens.usage: Money received: the amount and its arrow, on surface and surface-raised only (4.9:1). Always paired with a + sign and the in-arrow.

tokens.name: money-out
tokens.usage: Money spent: the amount and its arrow, on surface and surface-raised only (5.9:1). Always paired with a − sign and the out-arrow.

tokens.name: money-neutral
tokens.usage: Transfers between your own accounts: no sign, a lighter grey than any other amount, not counted in totals.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on surface and surface-raised (8.3:1).

tokens.name: focus-on-slate
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on slate (6.1:1).

tokens.name: bank-cbe
tokens.usage: Placeholder fill for the CBE badge until official bank marks are supplied. White text on it.

tokens.name: bank-telebirr
tokens.usage: Placeholder fill for the Telebirr badge until official marks are supplied. White text on it.

tokens.name: bank-boa
tokens.usage: Placeholder fill for the Bank of Abyssinia badge until official marks are supplied. White text on it.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The one big number on a screen: total balance on Home, the amount on a transaction. Set the decimals and currency in figure-unit.

styles.name: figure-l
styles.usage: Account balance on account detail, the amount on a review card, counts in onboarding.

styles.name: figure-unit
styles.usage: Decimals and currency after a figure, in on-slate-muted or ink-muted.

styles.name: figure-s
styles.usage: Small totals: this week, spent this month.

styles.name: title-l
styles.sample: Let Kash read your bank SMS
styles.usage: Onboarding and Welcome headlines. Break the line by hand so no word is left alone.

styles.name: title-m
styles.usage: Title of a tab screen, on slate.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The kash wordmark, lowercase, on Home and Welcome.

styles.name: title-xs
styles.usage: Title of a sub-page beside the back button.

styles.name: body-l
styles.usage: Paragraphs under onboarding headlines; text inputs.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Row names and list item titles.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Titles inside cards and lists of facts.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Row sublines, day headers (at 500), helper text.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Tiny labels next to figures on slate.

tokens.name: gap-xs
tokens.usage: Step segments, pager dots, icon-to-dot in the tab bar.

tokens.name: gap-s
tokens.usage: Between chips; between header icon buttons.

tokens.name: gap-m
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row (Review, add, accounts).

tokens.name: gap-l
tokens.usage: Between blocks on a sheet (search, chips, list).

tokens.name: gap-xl
tokens.usage: Between blocks in the slate hero.

tokens.name: inset-app
tokens.usage: Left and right padding of app screens, hero and sheet alike.

tokens.name: inset-onboarding
tokens.usage: Left and right padding of onboarding screens.

tokens.name: row-y
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding of a transaction row.

tokens.name: top-safe
tokens.usage: Space above the first header row (status bar area).

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of the sheet that rises over slate.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, the account card, the review card, list cards.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon buttons, search fields.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Text inputs, icon wells, bank badges at 40px.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Chips, badges inside buttons, small bank badges.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Switches and the sheet handle only.

tokens.name: button-h
tokens.usage: Full-width primary and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: button-h-compact
tokens.usage: Buttons inside the slate hero.

tokens.name: icon-button
tokens.usage: Icon buttons; the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: well-size
tokens.usage: Icon wells and bank badges in rows.

tokens.name: chip-h
tokens.usage: Filter and category chips.

tokens.name: tab-h
tokens.usage: Tab bar item height.
